svg.title: Why Prisma ORM Checks Types Faster Than Drizzle
svg.desc: A two-column comparison card on light paper: the schema benchmark's type instantiations (428 for Prisma ORM, 41,150 for Drizzle ORM) and check time (205 ms against 602 ms), with the Prisma ORM column tinted cyan under a spectral edge. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand.
